move verb

also shift, shift something

classical

Traupman 348

moveō, movēre

verb, second conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Other words

  • sē movēre (movērī) — move (oneself), stir

    also used · classical · Traupman 348: intr movērī, sē movēre

Examples

  • Tē hūc illūc movē.

    Move yourself back and forth; a simple prompt for swinging.composed

See also shake, roll, billow.

SourcesLewis & Short: moveo

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
